result_text:
`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` now leaves cancelled purchase orders out of each rep's count. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other purchase-order queries use. I also updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example. The full `mvn -q -o test` run finished with exit code 0, and `-q` hid the per-test output.

The ordering and the zero counts for reps with no purchase orders are unchanged, since the rep list is still driven by `sales_rep`.
